title: Terms & Conditions
content:
Last updated: 03/08/2026

These Terms and Conditions apply to Python consulting, software development, technical advice and related services provided by Stockgrove Brickhill Systems Ltd ("I", "me" or "my") to a client ("you" or "the client").

By engaging me to provide services, you agree to these Terms and Conditions together with any specific proposal, quotation or statement of work agreed between us.

1. Services

I provide Python software development and consulting services, which may include:

  • Python and Django development

  • Web application development

  • Software maintenance and troubleshooting

  • Technical advice and consultancy

  • Code review and improvement

  • Database and application development

  • System integration and automation

  • Other related technical services agreed with you

The precise services to be provided, deliverables, timescales and fees will be agreed with you before work begins.

2. Quotes and estimates

Where appropriate, I will provide an estimate or quotation for the work.

Unless expressly stated otherwise, estimates are indicative rather than fixed prices. The final cost may change where the scope of the work changes, requirements are unclear or additional work is requested.

Where a fixed price has been agreed, the work covered by that price will be described in the relevant proposal or statement of work.

3. Changes to requirements

If you request additional work or changes to the agreed specification, I will discuss the effect on the price and timescale with you before carrying out significant additional work.

Changes to requirements may affect the agreed delivery date.

4. Your responsibilities

You agree to provide information, access, materials, credentials and decisions reasonably required for me to perform the services.

You are responsible for ensuring that information and materials supplied by you are accurate and that you have the necessary rights and permissions to use them.

Delays caused by the late provision of information, access, feedback or decisions may result in corresponding changes to the delivery schedule.

5. Fees and payment

My fees will be agreed before work begins and may be based on an hourly rate, daily rate, fixed project price or another agreed basis.

Unless otherwise agreed, invoices are payable within [14/30] days of the invoice date.

All prices are [inclusive/exclusive] of VAT. Where VAT is applicable, it will be charged at the appropriate rate.

I reserve the right to suspend work where an invoice remains unpaid after its due date, having first notified you.

6. Delivery and acceptance

I will use reasonable care and skill in providing the services and will aim to meet any agreed deadlines.

Unless otherwise agreed, delivery dates are estimates and may be affected by circumstances outside my reasonable control or by changes or delays on the client's side.

Where software or other deliverables are supplied, you will have a reasonable opportunity to identify material defects or discrepancies against the agreed specification.

7. Software, code and intellectual property

Unless otherwise agreed in writing, you will receive the rights to use the specific software or other deliverables produced for you once all relevant invoices have been paid.

Any pre-existing software, libraries, tools, templates, techniques, know-how or other intellectual property belonging to me before the engagement remains mine.

Software supplied by third parties, including open-source software, remains subject to its own licence terms.

Unless agreed otherwise, I retain the right to use general knowledge, skills, techniques and experience acquired during an engagement, provided that doing so does not disclose your confidential information or infringe your intellectual property.

8. Client materials

You retain ownership of materials, data, software and other intellectual property that you provide to me.

You grant me permission to use those materials as reasonably necessary to provide the agreed services.

You warrant that you have the necessary rights and permissions for me to use materials you provide.

9. Confidentiality

I will treat confidential information supplied by you as confidential and will not disclose it to third parties except where:

  • you have authorised disclosure;

  • disclosure is necessary to provide the agreed services;

  • disclosure is required by law; or

  • the information is already publicly available through no breach of confidentiality.

You agree to treat any confidential information supplied by me in the same way.

10. Data protection

I will handle personal information in accordance with applicable data protection legislation and my Privacy Policy.

Where I process personal data on your behalf as part of providing services, we will agree any additional data-processing arrangements that are required.

You remain responsible for ensuring that any personal data or other information you provide to me may lawfully be provided for the purposes of the engagement.

11. Security and access

Where you provide access to systems, hosting accounts, databases, repositories or other services, you are responsible for providing appropriate permissions and for maintaining control of your accounts.

I will take reasonable steps to protect credentials and access information provided to me and will not intentionally access systems or information beyond what is reasonably necessary to perform the agreed work.

12. Backups

Unless specifically agreed otherwise, you are responsible for maintaining appropriate backups of your systems, databases, files and other data.

I will take reasonable care when working with your systems but cannot guarantee that data will never be lost or corrupted.

13. Third-party services

Your project may depend on third-party services, hosting providers, software libraries, APIs or other infrastructure.

I cannot guarantee the availability, performance, security, pricing or continued operation of third-party services that are outside my control.

Where appropriate, I will advise you of material third-party dependencies that I become aware of.

14. Liability

I will provide the services with reasonable care and skill.

Nothing in these Terms and Conditions excludes or limits liability where it would be unlawful to do so.

Subject to that, I will not be liable for indirect or consequential losses, loss of profits, loss of business, loss of anticipated savings or loss of opportunity arising from the services, except where such liability cannot lawfully be excluded.

Any agreed limitation of liability will be set out in the applicable proposal or contract and will be subject to applicable law.

15. Cancellation and termination

Either party may request termination of an ongoing engagement by giving [NUMBER] days' written notice, unless a different notice period has been agreed.

If an engagement is terminated, you remain responsible for payment for work properly completed and expenses reasonably incurred up to the termination date.

If either party materially breaches an agreement and fails to remedy that breach within a reasonable period after being notified, the other party may terminate the engagement.

Nothing in this section affects any statutory rights you may have.

16. Force majeure

I will not be responsible for delays or failure to perform caused by circumstances beyond my reasonable control, including significant technical failures, interruption of essential services, natural disasters, serious illness, industrial disputes or changes in law.

I will take reasonable steps to minimise the effect of such circumstances.

17. Complaints

If you have a concern about the services, please contact me as soon as reasonably possible at [EMAIL ADDRESS].

I will make reasonable efforts to understand and resolve complaints promptly and fairly.

18. Changes to these Terms

These Terms and Conditions may be updated from time to time.

The terms applying to a particular project will normally be those agreed when the relevant engagement begins, unless we subsequently agree otherwise in writing.

19. Governing law

These Terms and Conditions are governed by the law of England and Wales.

Any disputes will be subject to the jurisdiction of the courts of England and Wales, except where applicable law provides otherwise.

20. Contact

If you have any questions about these Terms and Conditions or would like to discuss my services, please contact:
